processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Five Cu molds movable stepwise inside furnace; 4-kg ingot; five alloys synthesized per operation; remaining melt adjusted by charging Al through an air lock.
10×50×130 mm³-sized blocks were hot rolled into 2±0.1 mm thick and ~500 mm long sheets.
After quenching, sheets were cut perpendicular to the rolling direction into sets of nine segments (2×60×55 mm³) per alloy composition.
Scales removed from surfaces after the heat treatments.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Samples for mechanical testing prepared from segments by package spark erosion; all plotted values represent averages of three measurements for every material state.

structures.overall_structure: fully recrystallized microstructure with some retained microsegregations of Mn

unmapped_findings: For the Al-free reference material (ternary Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy), the best mechanical behavior was reported for the as-homogenized state (a sibling state, not this 450 °C/24 h sample): 360 MPa YS, 830 MPa UTS, and 77% TE [b0023].

Aging of the Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy leaves the YS virtually unchanged and slightly increases hardness, but reduces UTS and TE; embrittlement is most apparent for long aging times (24 h) and higher temperatures (>500 °C). This 450 °C/24 h sample is a long-aging-time condition at the lower aging temperature [b0023, b0024].

No explicit numeric YS/UTS/TE value is printed for the exact 450 °C/24 h condition of the Al-free alloy; Fig. 3's colour key includes 450 °C/1 h but not 450 °C/24 h, so this sample is represented mainly through the qualitative aging trends in the text [figure_003, b0023, b0024].

In the Fig. 4 strength–ductility map, the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C series ('T + t' = 24 h aging trend) ranges from about 490 MPa at ~8% elongation to about 800 MPa at ~70% elongation (a broad trend line, not a specific 450 °C/24 h datum) [figure_004].

The as-cast samples had a coarse dendritic microstructure; hot rolling and water quenching produced the fully recrystallized state with ~20 µm grain size (parent processing states of this sample) [b0021].
A single austenite phase prevails at room temperature when the Al content is below 5 wt.%, which includes this Al-free (0 wt.% Al) Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy [b0015].
